malik.bio: A Medinan jurist known as the imam of the city of the Hijrah.
as: A leading figure in precision and careful verification.
Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما كان أشد انتقاد مالك للرجال وأعلمه بشأنهم
How exacting Mālik was in assessing transmitters and how well he knew their circumstances.
عمرو بن علي, quoted by al-Mizzī
أثبت من روى عن الزهري ممن لا يختلف فيه مالك بن أنس
Mālik ibn Anas was the strongest of the undisputed transmitters from al-Zuhrī.
محمد بن إسماعيل البخاري, quoted by al-Mizzī
مالك عن نافع عن ابن عمر
Asked for the soundest chain, al-Bukhārī said: Mālik from Nāfiʿ from Ibn ʿUmar.
Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd al-Qaṭṭān, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما في القوم أصح حديثا من مالك
None among them (al-Thawrī and Ibn ʿUyaynah) is more sound in hadith than Mālik.
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī, quoted by al-Mizzī
حدثنا مالك وهو أثبت من عبيد الله، وموسى بن عقبة، وإسماعيل بن أمية عن نافع
Mālik is more reliable from Nāfiʿ than ʿUbayd Allāh, Mūsā ibn ʿUqbah and Ismāʿīl ibn Umayyah.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
Mālik is sounder in hadith (from al-Zuhrī) than Ibn ʿUyaynah.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
Mālik is the most reliable in everything.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
ثقة، وهو أثبت في نافع من أيوب، وعبيد الله بن عمر، وليث بن سعد، وغيرهم
Trustworthy; more reliable from Nāfiʿ than Ayyūb, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, al-Layth ibn Saʿd and others.
When it comes to reports, Mālik is the star.
Wuhayb considered no one equal to Mālik.
ماكنت أقول إنه بقي أحد يحفظ هذا غيري
I did not think anyone but me still memorised this (after Mālik recited forty of his hadiths).
وكان مالك ثقة، مأمونا، ثبتا ورعا، فقيها، عالما، حجة
Mālik was trustworthy, reliable, firm, scrupulous, a jurist, learned, an authority.
أبو الأسود محمد ابن عبد الرحمن بن نوفل, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما ثم مثل فتى من ذي أصبح يقال له مالك بن أنس
There is none in Medina like a young man of Dhū Aṣbaḥ called Mālik ibn Anas (as a mufti).
وكان مالك ثقة مأمونا ثبتا ورعا فقيها عالما حجة
Mālik was reliable, trustworthy, firm in transmission and scrupulous, a learned jurist and an authority whose reports count as evidence.

t4200.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr al-Lakhmī al-Kūfī as trustworthy, eloquent and a scholar, whose memory changed and who sometimes practiced tadlīs, of the fourth generation, who died in the year 36 at age 103.
as: ثقة فصيح عالم تغير حفظه وربما دلس
Trustworthy, eloquent, a scholar; his memory changed and he sometimes practiced tadlīs.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
عبد الملك بن عمير مضطرب الحديث جدا مع قلة روايته ، ما أرى له خمس مئة حديث، وقد غلط في كثير منها
ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr’s hadith are very inconsistent despite his limited transmission. I do not think he has five hundred reports, and he made mistakes in many of them.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
سماك بن حرب أصلح حديثا من عبد الملك بن عمير، وذلك أن عبد الملك يختلف عليه الحفاظ
Simāk ibn Ḥarb’s hadith are more sound than ʿAbd al-Malik’s, since the master memorizers disagree over what ʿAbd al-Malik transmitted.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
أبو إسحاق الهمداني, quoted by al-Mizzī
خذوا العالم من عبد الملك بن عمير
Take knowledge from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr.
كان على قضاء الكوفة، وهو صالح الحديث، روى أكثر من مئة حديث
He was judge of Kufa. His hadith is acceptable, and he transmitted more than one hundred reports.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
ليس بحافظ، وهو صالح الحديث، تغير حفظه قبل موته
He was no master memorizer. His hadith is acceptable, and his memory changed before his death.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
هذا وهم، إنما هو عبد الملك بن أبي سليمان، وعبد الملك بن عمير لم يوصف بالحفظ
That is an error. It was ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Abī Sulaymān. Ibn ʿUmayr was not described as a master memorizer.
There is no objection to him.
He was among the most eloquent people.
ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī, quoted by al-Mizzī
He has about two hundred hadith.
كان سفيان الثوري يعجب من حفظ عبد الملك
Ibn Mahdī reports that al-Thawrī admired the memory of someone called ʿAbd al-Malik. Aḥmad identified him as Ibn ʿUmayr, and Abū Ḥātim identified him as Ibn Abī Sulaymān.
Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah, quoted by Ibn Saʿd
هما كبيرا أهل الكوفة يومئذ. هذا ابن مائة وهذا ابن مائة
He and Ziyād ibn ʿIlāqah were the two senior Kufans at the time. Each was a hundred years old.
أبو إسحاق, quoted by Ibn Saʿd
سلوا عبد الملك بن عمير وسماك بن حرب
Ask ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr and Simāk ibn Ḥarb.

t7393.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Wa'il ibn Hujr ibn Sa'd ibn Masruq al-Hadrami as a noble Companion, one of the kings of Yemen, who then settled in Kufa and died during Mu'awiya's governorship.
as: The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by al-Mizzī
هذا وائل بن حجر بقية الأقيال.
This is Wāʾil ibn Ḥujr, a survivor of the Yemeni chieftains.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by al-Mizzī
هذا وائل بن حجر سيد الأقيال جاءكم حبا لله ولرسوله.
This is Wāʾil ibn Ḥujr, chief of the Yemeni chieftains. He has come to you out of love for God and His Messenger.
النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
This is Wāʾil, chief of the Yemeni chieftains.
Ibn Ḥibbān, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
He was one of the last descendants of the kings of Ḥaḍramawt.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
يأتيكم وائل بن حجر من أرض بعيدة من حضرموت طائعا راغبا في الله وفي رسوله، وهو بقية أبناء الملوك.
Wāʾil ibn Ḥujr is coming to you from distant Ḥaḍramawt, obedient and seeking God and His Messenger. He is a surviving descendant of kings.
وكان وائل بن حجر زاجرا حسن الزجر
Wāʾil was skilled at interpreting omens.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
يأتيكم وائل بن حجر من أرض بعيدة، من حضرموت، طائعا راغبا في الله عز وجل وفي رسوله، وهو بقية أبناء الملوك
Wāʾil ibn Ḥujr is coming to you from distant Ḥaḍramawt, obedient and seeking God and His Messenger. He is a surviving descendant of kings.
I did not mean you. This looks better.
